title: MULTIPLE AWARD LAN/DLAN SIPR-NIPR BPA
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > AMC > ACC > ACC-OO > 413TH CSB > 0413 AQ HQ     RCO-HI
description:
The contractor shall provide all personnel, management, supervision, tools, testing apparatus, materials, Contractor-Furnished Material (CFM), transportation, and engineering services necessary to perform Inside Plant (ISP) structured cabling design, horizontal cable distribution, and fiber/copper installation, diagnostic troubleshooting, and repair across NIPRNET and SIPRNET physical layer infrastructure. The overarching operational objective is to modernize and sustain Department of Defense Information Network (DoDIN) physical transport architecture across US Army installations supported by the 30th Signal Battalion, Network Enterprise Center (NEC). 

 CLIN 0001 - Equipment for the installation of NIPR/SIPR requirement. 

 CLIN 0002 - Services for the installation of NIPR/SIPR requirement. 

 This posting is to determine the level of vendor interest for this opportunity which following approval/award will have a 5-year ordering period; will compete each requirement with award to lowest priced technically acceptable proposal.
